elements.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
elements.evidence: Client may assign without approval only to a “financially responsible affiliate,” not to any affiliate.

elements.element: Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
elements.evidence: No approval is required for Client’s assignment to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization, or sale of substantially all assets.

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
elements.evidence: TrueLink may assign to a financially responsible affiliate without Client’s approval.

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: Where Client’s approval is required, the clause states that approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed.

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no prohibition on assignment to a Client competitor.

elements.element: Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause grants TrueLink no termination right upon Client’s change of control and instead permits specified successor assignments without approval.

elements.element: Both parties may assign to a successor.
elements.evidence: The successor carve-out applies only “in the case of Client”; TrueLink has no corresponding right to assign to a successor without approval.

elements.element: A successor assignment requires written notice.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes no written-notice requirement for Client’s successor assignments.
Assignments to financially responsible affiliates do not require approval, even though they are not limited to successor assignments.

elements.element: Consent to other assignments is not to be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: For assignments requiring approval, the clause provides that approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed.
